thread:
maria: FYI opening a short thread to track postmortem follow-ups from the metering drift last night. finance-bot: Alert: 10 accounts with missing tokens, ~65k delta detected.
sam: I'll own the immediate remediation run. Plan: targeted partition backfill, then ledger reconciliation. ETA Tue EOD.
priya: I'll prep invoice-adjustment candidates and the customer-notice templates. Auto-credit threshold = <$200; above that route to finance review.
ops-lead: Root cause looks like compaction overlap + transient write-throttling. Infra PR to add index and adjust compaction schedule: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/2719. Assign infra long-term.
sam: Backfill approach: run dry-run first in 10m chunks, then live. Command: `./metering/backfill --id=bf-1217 --chunk=10m --dry-run`
dan: After Sam finishes live run I'll run reconcile and produce ledger-diff.csv with totals and per-account deltas. I'll flag any invoice candidates over $500.
priya: I'll prepare the CSV template for Support/Sales and include a short approval checkbox for finance for >$200.
ops-lead: Add acceptance criteria: ledger parity (0 token delta), backfill logs uploaded, reconcile CSV attached, and customer comms ready for any impacted accounts. Also tag incident tracker as recurring.
maria: Linking incident: https://redwood.internal/incidents/pm-541. Marking owner=sam for short-term; owner=infra for long-term.
sam: Backfill queued: job_id=bf-1217 region=us-west status=pending. Will post progress and job logs here.
priya: Will hold customer comms until reconcile output is final. Draft ready to share with Sales.
dan: Once reconcile CSV uploaded I'll attach it to the incident and add a short summary for finance sign-off.
maria: Recap: Sam (backfill) Tue EOD, Dan (reconcile) Wed AM, Priya (invoice+comms) Wed AM, Ops long-term. Thanks all :thumbsup:
